static_traits.name: Zhou Li雅
static_traits.social_status: 与同事关系受影响，被认为not够严肃；有室友可谈但尚not yet沟通此问题
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病，without既往心理治疗经历
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能自我Reflection，配合度高，态度积极；语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我not断感到自己without法认真对待生活中的任何事情，因而把Humor当作防御机制use。
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到自己without法认真、总用Humor当防御可能阻碍我实现目标，因此来寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: Since adolescence, gradually forming a pattern of using humor to avoid serious engagement in serious or stressful situations; in recent months this pattern has clearly intensified, evolving into almost always joking and finding it hard to have serious conversations.

There is a gap between the long-term ideal and reality (hoping to 'change the world', while in reality engaging in factory work), together with work pressure, bringing frustrating and tense experiences, strengthening the habit of using humor to buffer pressure.

core_beliefs: 我是一个without法认真对待事情的人
If I invest seriously, I will fail and disappoint others

special_situations.event: In the factory, the supervisor gives a serious talk about deadlines
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我严肃回应，do not人会看到我的紧张与not足，认为我not可靠；用Humor可以化解尴尬与压力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在严肃场合立即讲笑话、缓和气氛、Displacement话题
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只要我让他们笑，他们就not会看到我多紧张

special_situations.event: When facing challenges and responsibilities in work or life
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I take these challenges seriously, I might fail and disappoint people
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用Humor降低事件重要性，避免深入讨论与正面应对
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我总是not法认真对待事情

special_situations.event: 打算更认真地投入目标与职责时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Taking things seriously means greater risk: once I fail, I will disappoint others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces investment and uses joking self-mockery to buffer possible failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我认真起来，I will fail并让do not人失望

special_situations.event: 在被主管反馈“需要更认真”之后
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的批评说明我这个人本质上就not够好、not够可靠
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用Humor和自嘲掩饰尴尬与羞耻感，避免进一步严肃交流
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这说明我就是一个not被认真对待的人

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be treated as a reliable and trustworthy person, to be taken seriously, and to realize self-worth through serious commitment
core_conflict.fear: 害怕一旦认真就会失败、被评价、令他人失望，从而暴露自身not足
defense_goal: 通过Humor保持距离与掌控感，缓冲Anxiety与羞耻，避免被负面评价

object_relations.self_representation: 紧张、担心被看穿not足、需要用Humor掩饰的人
object_relations.object_representation: 严肃而带有评判性的他人（如上级、同事），可能会失望和negate

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When an authority figure (such as a supervisor) has a serious talk or makes demands or gives feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 对方在评判我是否可靠，如果我认真就会暴露not足、被negate（移情：将过去被评判的恐惧Projection到当前关系）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle and empathic tone, name the tension behind the humor and the fear of being judged, invite staying with the present feeling: for example, 'Just now you used a joke to ease the atmosphere, and I also felt you were a bit nervous; can we look together at what this nervousness is trying to protect you from?'

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When a more serious commitment and action regarding goals or responsibilities is needed
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认真等于更大失败风险与让他人失望
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以稳定的语速、具体化Questioning，引导连接情绪：“当你想到要认真投入时，身体里出现了什么感觉？我们先not解决，只是一起留意那份害怕。”

manifestations: The gap between the ideal of hoping to 'change the world' and the reality of factory work triggers frustration
借Humor淡化严肃议题，难以投入有意义的对话与行动
outcomes: Hard to have meaningful communication and deal with important issues

manifestations: 在面对责任与选择时以Humor回避严肃投入
担心一旦认真选择就要承担失败责任
outcomes: 行动受阻、目标推进停滞
自我评价下降并感到挫败与Anxiety

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact，与‘接受’对应。
manifestations: 在严肃或有压力的话题与场合中以玩笑Displacement注意，避免直接接触问题与情绪
用Humor来缓和紧张，绕开被评判或失败的恐惧

positive_force: 自我觉察较好，主动识do not并描述了Humor作为防御的模式
Has motivation to change, clearly hoping to be taken seriously and achieve goals
Humor在一定程度上有利于缓冲压力、建立连接
Positive attitude; willing to do self-monitoring (such as keeping a diary)
negative_force: 对失败与让他人失望的高度担忧
在严肃/压力情境中过度依赖Humor回避，形成固定反应
过度概括、读心、个人化等认知偏差
Long-term frustration and work pressure from the gap between reality and the ideal (changing the world)

target_behavior.behavior: 在严肃或压力情境中以讲笑话/Humor方式回避严肃沟通与投入
antecedent: Supervisor holds a serious talk or sets deadline demands
When facing challenges and responsibilities in work or life
Occasions requiring serious communication with colleagues or others
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心一旦认真投入就会失败并让他人失望，伴随显著紧张与Anxiety，因而以Humor缓冲与掩饰
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪（紧张、羞耻、被评判），以及避免潜在的负面评价
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected、被同事与上级视为not够严肃；难以进行有意义的对话与处理重要问题
